note: Video Embed HTML5 adds one video_embed_field provider plugin, html_5, matching URLs ending in mp4/ogg/webm and rendering a native <video> via the video_embed_html5 theme. Its only config is video_embed_html5.config (add_placeholder bool default true; placeholder file id, default null), form route video_embed_html5.config.form. A field is restricted to this provider via the video_embed_field field setting allowed_providers=['html_5']. Medium cases read a known add_placeholder value and a known allowed_providers on a created field (field_veh_known). Hard cases create a namespaced video_embed field restricted to html_5 (field_veh_video) and toggle the placeholder config. Fields are namespaced field_veh_*, and scripts restore add_placeholder=true. No drush cr (config/entity reads are live) to avoid an unrelated shared-site group-module cache-rebuild fault.

evals.prompt: The video_embed_html5 module adds an HTML5 provider to Video Embed Field. What kind of video URLs does that provider recognise?
evals.expected_output: The html_5 provider's getIdFromInput() regex matches any URL ending in mp4, ogg, or webm; those direct video links render in a native HTML5 <video> player.

evals.prompt: How do I embed a self-hosted MP4 video on a node using video_embed_html5?
evals.expected_output: Add a Video Embed field (from video_embed_field) to the content type and paste a direct link ending in .mp4 (or .ogg/.webm). The html_5 provider handles it automatically and renders a native <video> element.

evals.prompt: What settings does video_embed_html5 expose, in which config object, and what do they control?
evals.expected_output: video_embed_html5.config has add_placeholder (bool, default true) and placeholder (an optional uploaded image). They control whether/what placeholder image shows while a client-side (canvas) thumbnail is generated when php_ffmpeg is not installed. Set at /admin/config/media/video-embed-html5.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the video_embed_html5 placeholder behaviour has been changed from its default. Inspect the live configuration and state whether the 'add placeholder' option is currently enabled or disabled.
evals.expected_output: add_placeholder is false (disabled) in video_embed_html5.config; the shipped default is true.

evals.prompt: The Article content type has a Video Embed field that has been restricted to a single provider. Inspect the live field configuration and state which video provider it is limited to.
evals.expected_output: The field_veh_known Video Embed field has allowed_providers set to ['html_5'] (only the HTML5 provider), in FieldConfig node.article.field_veh_known.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Video Embed field named field_veh_video to the Article content type and restrict it so that only the HTML5 provider is allowed. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A video_embed_field field storage node.field_veh_video exists on the article bundle, and its FieldConfig allowed_providers setting is ['html_5'].

evals.prompt: On this site, turn off the 'add placeholder while generating video thumbnail' option for Video Embed HTML5, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: video_embed_html5.config add_placeholder is set to false.
